_note: Single source of truth for Line of Command V1 balance numbers. spec.md quotes these values; if they disagree, this file wins and spec.md is the bug.

attributes.soft_cap_rule: if raw > 80: base = max(80, midparent); if raw > base: raw = base + (raw - base) * 0.4

skills: not inherited; offspring starts with skills.starting_value

bloodline.inherits: player picks either parent's house name
bloodline.prestige: mean officer_rating of the officer and recorded ancestors up to 3 generations back (display only)

preview.show_trait_odds: only for alleles already revealed in the pedigree

starter_roster.status: D14 DECIDED 2026-11-22 (captain): new accounts start with 3 officers.
starter_roster.attributes: attributes.innate.new_officer (Normal 40, sd 9, clamped 20-60), each attribute independent
starter_roster.traits: founder rule (traits.json): 2 alleles per slot drawn from the library; the expressed strength and weakness are always 1 visible each
starter_roster.variety_rule: the 3 starters have pairwise different expressed strengths and pairwise different expressed weaknesses; re-draw a later starter's genotype (same seeded RNG) until this holds, max 50 tries, then keep the last draw
starter_roster.pairing_rule: V1 has no sex mechanic: any 2 different officers can breed. Starters have no parents and are unrelated (no inbreeding penalty), so all 3 pairs are legal from day 1; each parent still needs 3 ranked battles first (limits.min_battles_to_breed), so the earliest first breed is day 2

roster.status: D10 DECIDED 2026-11-22 (captain): cap 20, manual release, pedigree ghosts.
roster.pedigree_ghosts: A released officer is removed from the barracks but stays as a read-only ghost entry (id, name, house, parents, attributes, expressed traits, revealed alleles) so pedigrees, inbreeding checks, carrier visibility and bloodline prestige still work. Ghosts cannot fight, breed or train and do not use roster slots.
